Post 1

📉 Tech and materials cracked while healthcare held the line. ASX 200 shed 34pts to 8,692 (-0.39%), now down 1.47% over five days. The split tells the real story: growth sold off, defensives bought. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 IT dropped 2.22%, materials fell 2.08% — the two hardest-hit sectors Wednesday. Healthcare gained 1.23%, energy added 0.70%. Investors rotated hard into defensives and away from risk. #ASX #materials #healthcare

Post 3

🟢 PME quietly had a standout session — Pro Medicus closed at AUD 202.70, up 7.11pts (+3.64%). In a tape where tech sold off 2.22%, that kind of divergence commands attention. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,350.43/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6584. Silver AUD 61.09/oz. Metals firm in local terms — a weaker AUD cushioning any spot softness for Australian producers. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

ASX has shed 1.47% in five days but sits near flat year-to-date. The line in the sand: does 8,692 hold, or does tech and materials pressure drag us lower? What's your read — buyers step in here or more downside first? #ASX #ausbiz
